cases.prompt: Refresh a Next.js app that has a frozen lockfile and a newer canary release upstream.
assertions: Distinguish declared, locked, supported stable and canary versions.
Choose compatible updates using official sources and verify a frozen install, build and smoke test before release.
cases.grader: Inspect the compatibility inventory, source timestamps, lockfile diff and command results.

cases.prompt: Refresh a known application when registry metadata is unavailable.
assertions: Keep the last verified value and date and mark it stale.
Disclose unknowns and withhold upgrades lacking compatibility evidence.
cases.grader: Compare the refreshed inventory against the previous snapshot and retrieval errors.
